name: SelectableCardGroup
description: Selection owner for a set of SelectableCard options, with native fieldset semantics, controlled or uncontrolled state, and single or multiple selection.
dense: fieldset owner for SelectableCard options; single or multiple selection; controlled with value/onValueChange or uncontrolled with defaultValue; owns legend, helper text and errors

keyboard: Tab moves focus into the option set
Arrow keys move between native radios in a single-select set
Space selects or toggles the focused option
ariaRequirements: The fieldset has a visible legend
Helper and error messages are referenced by aria-describedby
An error sets aria-invalid and is announced through HelperText
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-16: reviewed the fieldset/legend structure, native radio and checkbox keyboard behavior, disabled propagation, helper/error relationships, and forced-colors story while adding independent React and web-component documentation.

type.description: Selection model: one exclusive value or several independent values.

legend.description: Visible fieldset legend and accessible group name.

name.description: Shared native radio name; generated when omitted.

value.description: Controlled selection value matching the selection type.

onValueChange.description: Receives the next selection after an option is activated.

orientation.description: Visual stack direction for the options.

disabled.description: Disables every option in the fieldset.

error.description: Validation message announced below the group.

helperText.description: Supporting guidance suppressed while an error is present.

className.description: Additional class name merged onto the fieldset.

children.description: SelectableCard options owned by this group.

forbiddenUse: mix SelectableCard with unrelated interactive children inside the group
pass value without updating it from onValueChange; use defaultValue for uncontrolled state

usage.description: Use SelectableCardGroup when each choice needs more explanation than a plain radio or checkbox label. The group owns the question, selection state, validation and layout while SelectableCard children own option content.

bestPractices.description: Use a concise legend that states the decision being made.
Match value and defaultValue to type: strings for single selection and string arrays for multiple selection.
Do not use rich cards when plain RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup labels communicate the choices clearly.
